source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 5 (PDF 126-152), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Data Analytics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is model building?
(Model building kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Model building mushkil masail ki saada shakal (simplified representation) banane ka amal hai. Yeh aham hisson par tawajjuh de kar asal duniya ke masail samajhne, un ka tajziya karne aur hal karne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Model building is the process of creating simplified representations of complex problems

blocks.prompt:
2 Define a model and state what it helps us to do.
(Model ki definition likhein aur batayein ke yeh kis kaam aata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Model kisi mushkil masle ya surat-e-haal ko saada tareeqe se dekhne ka zariya hai. Yeh cheezon ko samajhne, wazeh karne ya un ki peshgoi (prediction) karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps to understand, explain, or predict how things work

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is a model compared with a map of a city?
(Model ko shehar ke naqshe (map) se kyon tashbeeh di jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naqsha sirf sarakain aur nishaniyan dikha kar shehar mein raasta dhoondne mein madad deta hai. Isi tarah model sab se aham hisson par tawajjuh de kar aur ghair zaroori tafseel chhor kar masla samjhata hai.

book_ref.quote: a model helps us understand a problem by focusing on the most important parts and leaving out unnecessary details

blocks.prompt:
4 How is a student's study plan an example of a model?
(Talib-e-ilm ka study plan model ki misaal kaise hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har subject ko kitna waqt dena hai, yeh tay karne ke liye talib-e-ilm study plan banata hai. Yeh aham subjects par tawajjuh de kar aur kam zaroori kaam chhor kar schedule saada banata hai, is liye yeh model hai.

book_ref.quote: To decide how much time to spend on each subject, the student creates a study plan

blocks.prompt:
5 Give two reasons why models are useful in decision making.
(Faisla karne mein model ke mufeed hone ki do wajoohat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Model masle par munazzam (structured) tareeqe se sochne dete hain aur mushkil maloomat ko aasan banate hain.
2. Yeh faisle se pehle mukhtalif nataij (outcomes) par ghaur karne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: They take complicated information and make it easier to work with

blocks.prompt:
6 How does a model help a farmer?
(Model kisan ki kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mausam ke patterns aur mitti ki halat (soil conditions) parh kar model kisan ko fasal lagane ka sahi waqt batata hai, jis se achhi fasal ka imkaan barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: which increases the chances of a good harvest

blocks.prompt:
7 Name three fields in which models are commonly applied.
(Teen shobe batayein jahan model aam istemal hote hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Weather forecasting (mausam ki peshgoi)
2. Financial predictions (maali peshgoi)
3. Scientific research (scienci tehqeeq)

book_ref.quote: Some common fields where models are applied include weather forecasting, financial predictions, and scientific research

blocks.prompt:
8 How are models used in weather forecasting?
(Weather forecasting mein model kaise istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Meteorologists (mausam ke mahireen) temperature, humidity (nami) aur hawa ki raftaar jaisa data jama karte hain, phir model se is ka tajziya kar ke mausam ki peshgoi karte hain.

book_ref.quote: and then use models to analyze this data and forecast the weather

blocks.prompt:
9 What do banks and companies predict with models?
(Banks aur companies model se kis cheez ki peshgoi karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Banks aur companies model se maashi rujhanat (economic trends), stock prices aur customers ke rawayye ki peshgoi karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Models are also very important in the financial world

blocks.prompt:
10 What is statistics? Name its basic concepts.
(Statistics kya hai? Is ke bunyadi concepts ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Statistics mathematics ki shakh hai jo data samajhne, tajziya karne aur bari maloomat ka saada khulasa banane mein madad deti hai. Bunyadi concepts: descriptive statistics, central tendency, dispersion aur probability.

book_ref.quote: By using statistics, we can summarize large sets of information in a simple way

blocks.text: 5.2.1 Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)

blocks.prompt:
11 What are measures of central tendency? Name them.
(Central tendency ke paimane kya hain? Un ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Central tendency (markazi rujhan) ke paimane data ki markazi ya aam value batate hain. Teen bare paimane mean, median aur mode hain.

book_ref.quote: Measures of central tendency help us find the

blocks.prompt:
12 Find the mean of the marks 12, 15, 18, 21 and 24.
(Marks 12, 15, 18, 21 aur 24 ka mean nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean = values ka jama / values ki tadaad = 90/5 = 18.

book_ref.quote: The mean is the average of all the numbers in a data set

blocks.prompt:
13 Find the median of 7, 3, 9, 3, 5, 11, 3 and 8.
(7, 3, 9, 3, 5, 11, 3 aur 8 ka median nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb: 3, 3, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11. Values 8 (juft) hain, is liye do beech wali values ka average: (5 + 7)/2 = 6.

book_ref.quote: The median is the middle value when the numbers are arranged in order

blocks.prompt:
14 Find the mode of 7, 3, 9, 3, 5, 11, 3 and 8. Can a data set have more than one mode?
(7, 3, 9, 3, 5, 11, 3 aur 8 ka mode nikalein. Kya data ke aik se zyada mode ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 3 teen dafa aata hai, is liye mode 3 hai. Haan, agar kayi numbers barabar sab se zyada dafa aayen to aik se zyada mode hote hain (jaise 50, 60, 70, 70, 60, 90 mein 60 aur 70).

book_ref.quote: The mode helps us identify the most frequent or common value in the data

blocks.prompt:
15 Differentiate between mean and median.
(Mean aur median mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean average value hai; median tarteeb diye gaye data ki beech wali value hai.

book_ref.quote: These measures give us a sense of the average or most common values in a dataset

rows: Data ke sab numbers ka average.
Tarteeb diye gaye numbers ki beech wali value.
Sab numbers jama kar ke tadaad se taqseem karte hain.
Taaq tadaad: beech wala number; juft tadaad: do beech walon ka average.

blocks.prompt:
16 What are descriptive statistics? Why are they useful?
(Descriptive statistics kya hain? Yeh kyon mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics data ka khulasa (summary) aur tarteeb dete hain. Har aik value dekhne ke bajaye yeh poori tasveer dikha dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Instead of looking at every individual piece of data

blocks.prompt:
17 Ten students scored 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 and 88. Give the mean, the highest and the lowest score.
(Das talaba ke scores 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 aur 88 hain. Mean, sab se zyada aur sab se kam score batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Jama = 758, mean = 758/10 = 75.8. Sab se zyada score 95, sab se kam 50. (Kitab 75.5 likhti hai; durusti 75.8 hai.)

book_ref.quote: Imagine a group of 10 college students takes a math exam

blocks.prompt:
18 What are measures of dispersion? Name two of them.
(Dispersion ke paimane kya hain? Do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dispersion (phelao) ke paimane batate hain ke data kitna phela hua hai, yani values mean ke qareeb hain ya door. Do aam paimane variance aur standard deviation hain.

book_ref.quote: These help us understand whether the data points are close to the average (mean) or far from it

blocks.prompt:
19 What does a higher or a lower variance tell us about a data set?
(Zyada ya kam variance data ke bare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Variance batata hai ke numbers mean se kitne mukhtalif hain. Zyada variance: numbers zyada phele hue; kam variance: numbers mean ke qareeb.

book_ref.quote: A higher variance means that the numbers are more spread out

blocks.prompt:
20 Write the formula of variance and explain its symbols.
(Variance ka formula likhein aur is ki alamaat wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)², i = 1 se N tak; xᵢ har value, μ data ka mean aur N values ki kul tadaad hai.

book_ref.quote: To calculate variance, we use the following mathematical formula

blocks.prompt:
21 Calculate the variance of 12, 15, 18, 21 and 24.
(12, 15, 18, 21 aur 24 ka variance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
μ = 18. Deviations ke square: 36, 9, 0, 9, 36; jama 90.
σ² = 90/5 = 18.

book_ref.quote: Steps are involved in variance calculations

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between variance and standard deviation.
(Variance aur standard deviation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono phelao naapte hain; standard deviation variance ka square root hai.

book_ref.quote: The standard deviation is similar to variance but provides a more practical number

rows: Batata hai ke numbers mean se kitne mukhtalif hain.
Mean ke lihaz se phelao zyada amli (practical) number mein batata hai.
σ² = (1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)²
σ = √((1/N) Σ (xᵢ − μ)²), variance ka square root.
Class A: 12.56

blocks.prompt:
23 The variance of a data set is 18. Find its standard deviation and say what a small value means.
(Data ka variance 18 hai. Standard deviation nikalein aur batayein ke chhoti value ka kya matlab hai.)
blocks.explanation: Standard deviation = √18 ≈ 4.24. Chhoti standard deviation ka matlab values mean ke qareeb jama hain; bari ka matlab door door phaili hain.

book_ref.quote: This means that Class A's scores are closely packed around the mean

blocks.prompt:
24 Define probability and write its formula.
(Probability ki definition aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Probability (imkaan) yeh mutaala hai ke koi waqiya hone ka kitna imkaan hai; is se nataij ki peshgoi hoti hai.
Probability = favourable nataij / kul nataij.

book_ref.quote: It helps us predict outcomes based on what we know

blocks.prompt:
25 What is the probability of getting heads when a coin is flipped? Give reason.
(Sikka uchhalne par heads aane ki probability kya hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Do barabar imkaan wale nataij hain (heads ya tails) aur un mein aik favourable hai, is liye P(heads) = 1/2 = 50%.

book_ref.quote: Consider flipping a coin. There are two possible outcomes: heads or tails

blocks.prompt:
26 Why are data collection and preparation crucial steps in any analysis?
(Kisi bhi tajziye mein data collection aur preparation aham qadam kyon hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyon ke data ki quality aur relevance (mutabiqat) study ke nataij aur insights par barah-e-raast asar dalti hai.

book_ref.quote: In order to carry out any research or analysis, data collection and preparation are crucial steps

blocks.prompt:
27 Define data collection and name its three methods.
(Data collection ki definition likhein aur is ke teen tareeqon ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Data collection kisi khaas maqsad ke liye mutalliqa maloomat jama karne ka amal hai. Tareeqe: surveys, observations aur experiments.

book_ref.quote: These methods include surveys, observations, and experiments

blocks.prompt:
28 What is a survey? Name two means of conducting it.
(Survey kya hai? Is ke do zaraye batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Survey aik sample group se pehle se tay sawal poochh kar munazzam tareeqe se bohat sa data jama karta hai. Yeh online forms, telephone calls ya aamne saamne interviews se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Surveys are a commonly used method for collecting large amounts of data in a structured way

blocks.prompt:
29 How did the grocery store in Islamabad use its survey?
(Islamabad ki grocery store ne survey ko kaise istemal kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Us ne weekend par 50 customers ko paanch sawalon ka survey diya aur jawabat ka tajziya kar ke woh products rakhe jo customers chahte thay; is se karobar behtar hua.

book_ref.quote: The collected responses are then analyzed to stock products that align with customer demand

blocks.prompt:
30 Give the chapter's example of data collection by observation.
(Observation se data jama karne ki chapter wali misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Restaurant ka staff member aik hafta dekhta hai ke dopehar ko customers kaun si tables chunte hain. Phir restaurant aaram aur customers ki aasan aamad-o-raft ke liye seating tarteeb deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A restaurant is interested in knowing which tables are most frequently chosen by customers during lunchtime

blocks.prompt:
31 Differentiate between a survey and an observation.
(Survey aur observation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Survey sawal poochhta hai; observation baghair dakhal dekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Observation involves collecting data by watching or monitoring subjects

rows: Sample group se pehle se tay sawal poochhna.
Qudrati mahol mein dekhna ya nigrani karna.
Online forms, telephone ya aamne saamne interview se.
Baghair dakhal rawayye ya waqiyat ka data.
Misaal: 50 customers ka grocery survey.
Misaal: aik hafta restaurant ki tables dekhna.

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between an observation and an experiment.
(Observation aur experiment mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Observation dakhal nahin deti; experiment jaan boojh kar variables badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Experiments involve manipulating one or more variables

rows: Qudrati mahol mein dekh kar data.
Aik ya zyada variables badal kar doosre par asar dekhna.
Koi dakhal nahin.
Durust naap ke liye controlled mahol.
Rawayye ke liye, jaise restaurant seating.
Science aur engineering mein, jaise printed notes test.

blocks.prompt:
33 Describe the teacher's printed-notes experiment briefly.
(Teacher ke printed notes wale experiment ko mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Teacher do groups banata hai: aik ko printed notes milte hain, doosra sirf lectures par. Aik maah baad dono aik hi test dete hain aur nataij mila kar dekha jata hai ke notes se karkardagi behtar hui ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: After one month, both groups take the same test

blocks.prompt:
34 What does data preparation include?
(Data preparation mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data se ghaltiyan ya be-ittefaqiyan hatana, use ba-maani tarteeb dena aur tajziye ke qabil format mein badalna. Ghayab ya ghalat data ke liye interpolation ya statistical adjustments.

book_ref.quote: Once data has been collected, it is important to prepare it for analysis

blocks.prompt:
35 Why are data cleaning and transformation important?
(Data cleaning aur transformation kyon zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khaam data mein aksar ghaltiyan, missing values ya ghalat format hota hai. Durust nataij ke liye tajziye se pehle inhein theek karna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: To ensure accurate results in analysis, it is important to fix these issues before moving forward

blocks.prompt:
36 Define data cleaning. Name the problems it fixes.
(Data cleaning ki definition likhein. Yeh kaun se masail theek karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data cleaning data ke masail theek karna ya hatana hai: ghalat entries, missing values aur duplicate data. Theek na hon to nataij gumrah-kun honge.

book_ref.quote: These problems can include incorrect entries, missing values, or duplicate data

blocks.prompt:
37 In Table 5.2, what two corrections are made in the cleaned data?
(Table 5.2 ke saaf data mein kaun si do durustiyan ki gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Ghalat likha naam "Alie" durust kar ke "Ali" kiya gaya.
2. Sara ka missing grade (75) bhara gaya, is tarah data mukammal hua.

book_ref.quote: In this case, data cleaning would involve correcting any wrong names and finding the missing grades

blocks.prompt:
38 What is data transformation? Give two examples.
(Data transformation kya hai? Do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Cleaning ke baad transformation data ko aise format mein badalti hai jis par kaam aasan ho aur tajziya/modelling ke qabil ho. Misaalein: format badalna, naye columns banana (ya data ko nayi tarteeb dena).

book_ref.quote: These changes help make the data more suitable for analysis or modeling

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between data cleaning and data transformation.
(Data cleaning aur data transformation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cleaning masail theek karti hai; transformation saaf data ka format badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: it is often necessary to transform it into a format that is easy to work with

rows: Data ke masail theek karna ya hatana.
Saaf data ko aasan format mein badalna.
Ghalat entries, missing values aur duplicates theek karna.
Format badalna, naye columns, nayi tarteeb.
Pehle hoti hai taa ke nataij gumrah-kun na hon.
Cleaning ke baad, tajziye/modelling ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
40 Name three techniques for handling missing data.
(Missing data sambhalne ki teen techniques ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Imputation (mojooda data se andaza)
2. Flagging (note lagana ke value mojood nahin)
3. Removal (kam entries hon to record nikalna)

book_ref.quote: There are different techniques to handle missing data

blocks.prompt:
41 Differentiate between imputation and flagging.
(Imputation aur flagging mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Imputation khala andaze se bharti hai; flagging khala chhor kar nishan lagati hai.

book_ref.quote: This approach allows the school to maintain a complete dataset while making a reasonable assumption

rows: Mojooda data se missing value ka andaza.
Note lagana ke value mojood nahin.
Misaal: Sara ko filhal class average 82 dena.
Misaal: Sara ke record par missing grade ka nishan.
Data mukammal rehta hai, mohtat andaza.
Shaffafiyat; khala bhare baghair tajziya.

blocks.prompt:
42 When is removal of a record acceptable, and what is its risk?
(Record nikalna (removal) kab theek hai aur is ka khatra kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Removal tab theek hai jab missing entries kam hon aur majmooi samajh par khaas asar na pare. Khatra: us talib-e-ilm ki qeemti maloomat kho jana.

book_ref.quote: This decision is acceptable if it does not significantly impact the overall understanding of student performance

blocks.prompt:
43 What is statistical modeling? Give an example.
(Statistical modeling kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Statistical modeling data se duniya samajhne aur mustaqbil ki peshgoi karne ka tareeqa hai. Misaal: pichle grocery kharch se agle maah ka kharch, khandan ke size ya khaas mauqon ko shamil kar ke.

book_ref.quote: By analyzing that data, you can create a model to help you estimate your future grocery expenses

blocks.prompt:
44 List the five steps of building a statistical model.
(Statistical model banane ke paanch qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Masla wazeh karna
2. Data jama karna
3. Algorithm chunna
4. Model train karna
5. Model ki jaanch (evaluate)

book_ref.quote: Based on the problem and the data, we choose an algorithm

blocks.prompt:
45 What is an algorithm in model development? Name two popular ones.
(Model development mein algorithm kya hai? Do mashhoor algorithms ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Algorithms woh tareeqe hain jo model banane mein madad dete hain; masle aur data ke mutabiq chune jate hain. Do mashhoor: linear regression aur logistic regression.

book_ref.quote: Some popular algorithms are linear regression and logistic regression

blocks.prompt:
46 Why is the model evaluated with new data?
(Model ki jaanch naye data se kyon ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naye data se test karne se pata chalta hai ke model un values par kitna achha hai jin se us ne nahin seekha. Is se yaqeeni hota hai ke peshgoi achhi hai.

book_ref.quote: This step is very important to ensure the model makes good predictions

blocks.prompt:
47 What is linear regression? Write its formula.
(Linear regression kya hai? Is ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Linear regression do variables ka talluq samajhne aur aik se doosre ki peshgoi karne wala aam statistical model hai.
Y = β₀ + β₁X + ε

book_ref.quote: It is often used to predict one variable based on another

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between the independent and the dependent variable in linear regression.
(Linear regression mein independent aur dependent variable mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Independent variable wajah hai; dependent variable asar hai.

book_ref.quote: Here, the number of customers is our independent variable (X), and the daily earnings are the dependent variable (Y)

rows: Wajah; is se peshgoi ki jati hai.
Asar; isi ki peshgoi hoti hai.
Formula mein X.
Formula mein Y.
Fruit stall: customers ki tadaad.
Fruit stall: rozana kamai.

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between slope and intercept in a linear regression model.
(Linear regression mein slope aur intercept mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Slope X ki har ikai par Y ki tabdeeli hai; intercept X = 0 par Y hai.

book_ref.quote: is the slope, which shows how much Y changes with each unit increase in X

rows: X ki har ikai barhne par Y kitna badalta hai.
X = 0 par Y ki shuruati value.
Har naya customer 40 rupay barhata hai.
Koi customer na ho phir bhi 100 rupay.

blocks.prompt:
50 Using Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers, predict the earnings for 18 customers.
(Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers se 18 customers ki kamai ki peshgoi karein.)
blocks.explanation: Earnings = 100 + 720 = 820 rupay.

book_ref.quote: This means that with 22 customers, you can expect to earn around 980 rupees

blocks.prompt:
51 A model predicts 1,220 rupees for 28 customers but 1,250 rupees were earned. What is the error, and what does it show?
(Model 28 customers ke liye 1,220 rupay batata hai magar 1,250 kamaye gaye. Error kya hai aur yeh kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Error = 1,220 − 1,250 = −30 rupay. Peshgoi qareeb thi magar bilkul theek nahin, yani asal duniya ke data mein kuch farq (variation) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: While the prediction was close, it's not perfect, showing that real-world data often has some variation

blocks.prompt:
52 Give two suggestions for improving a statistical model.
(Statistical model behtar karne ki do tajaweez dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Behtar durusti ke liye zyada data points.
2. Model ko naye data se baqaidagi se update karna.
(Neez: khandan ke size jaise factors shamil karna; peshgoi ko asal se milana.)

book_ref.quote: Include relevant factors like family size or special events that may affect spending

blocks.prompt:
53 Differentiate between linear regression and logistic regression.
(Linear regression aur logistic regression mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Linear regression theek number batati hai; logistic regression haan/na nateeje ki probability batati hai.

book_ref.quote: Logistic regression is different from linear regression because it doesn

rows: Dependent variable ka theek number.
Haan ya na nateeje ki probability.
Koi bhi value, jaise 980 rupay.
0 aur 1 ke darmiyan, jaise 0.85.
Y = β₀ + β₁X + ε
Misaal: customers se kamai.
Misaal: ghanton se pass ya fail.

blocks.prompt:
54 A logistic regression model gives 0.85 for passing an exam. Interpret this value.
(Logistic model pass hone ke liye 0.85 deta hai. Is value ki tashreeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh probability hai: parhai ke ghanton ki bunyad par talib-e-ilm ke pass hone ka 85% imkaan hai.

book_ref.quote: This means it tells us how likely something is to happen

blocks.prompt:
55 In the logistic model of study hours, what do β₀ and β₁ represent?
(Parhai ke ghanton wale logistic model mein β₀ aur β₁ kya zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
β₀ intercept hai: koi ghanta na parhne par pass hone ke log-odds.
β₁ ghanton ka coefficient hai: har izafi ghante par log-odds kitne badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: is the intercept of the model, which represents the log-odds of passing when no hours are studied

blocks.prompt:
56 With P(pass) = 1 / (1 + e^−(1 + 0.6 × Hours)), find the probability of passing for 0 hours of study.
(P(pass) = 1 / (1 + e^−(1 + 0.6 × Hours)) se 0 ghante parhne par pass probability nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: This means that for each hour studied, the likelihood of passing the exam increases

blocks.prompt:
57 What is clustering? Give an example.
(Clustering kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Clustering milti julti cheezon ko un ki khususiyat ki bunyad par group karna hai. Misaal: class ke talaba ko math aur English mein milti julti karkardagi ke groups mein baantna.

book_ref.quote: Clustering helps us do that by creating groups of students who perform similarly

blocks.prompt:
58 How does K-means decide which student joins which cluster?
(K-means kaise tay karta hai ke kaun sa talib-e-ilm kis cluster mein jaye?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh har talib-e-ilm ke scores ka har cluster centre se faasla (Euclidean distance) nikalta hai aur use qareeb tareen centre wale cluster mein dalta hai.

book_ref.quote: K-means clustering is one of the simplest and most popular techniques to group data

blocks.prompt:
59 Find the Euclidean distance between the score points (85, 70) and (60, 60).
(Score points (85, 70) aur (60, 60) ka Euclidean distance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: We calculate the distance of each student

blocks.prompt:
60 When does the K-means algorithm stop?
(K-means algorithm kab rukta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Step 3 (qareeb tareen centre) aur step 4 (centres dobara nikalna) tab tak dohraye jate hain jab tak centres badalna band na kar dein; tab clusters mustahkam hain.

book_ref.quote: This process continues until the centers no longer change
